Is Day One Gold worth it? How it compares with Auserene
Auserene or Day One? An honest comparison from one of them

faq.q: Is Auserene better than Day One?
faq.a: It depends on what you want. Day One is better for a long-term archive with photos and video, for Android, Windows and the web, for print books and for end-to-end encryption, and its AI plan costs less. Auserene is better if you want an evening AI conversation built from your day's notes, a memory you can read and edit, and a meditation made from your day. Auserene is iPhone only.

Yes, on the Gold plan. Day One's AI features include Daily Chat, Go Deeper prompts, entry highlights, title suggestions, image generation and summaries. Daily Chat uses OpenAI, and some features can run on-device with Apple Intelligence.

faq.q: What is Day One Daily Chat?
faq.a: Daily Chat is Day One's AI conversation feature. It asks questions about your day and turns the conversation into a journal entry you can edit. It builds memories of your routines and relationships, but Day One says you can't review or delete individual memories in its iPhone, iPad or Mac apps.

faq.q: How much is Day One Gold?
faq.a: Day One Gold costs $74.99 a year in the US as of November 2026. Silver costs $49.99 a year, and Basic is free. Day One offers a one-month free trial in the app. A monthly Gold price isn't listed on its pricing page.

faq.q: Is Day One Gold worth it?
faq.a: If you already use Day One and want Daily Chat and AI summaries, Gold costs $25 a year more than Silver and keeps everything Silver has. If you want memory you can review on iPhone, mood tracking or meditation, Gold doesn't list them.

faq.q: Is Day One still end-to-end encrypted if I use AI?
faq.a: Day One offers end-to-end encryption on every plan. Its AI guide says content from end-to-end encrypted journals is temporarily not end-to-end encrypted while being processed by AI, and that content isn't used to train AI models. Auserene isn't end-to-end encrypted at all.

informationGain: A disclosed head-to-head built only from Day One's own pages on November 19, 2026, including its admission that Daily Chat memories can't be reviewed or deleted in its Apple apps, that AI temporarily lifts end-to-end encryption and routes Daily Chat to OpenAI, and the missing monthly Gold price, set against Auserene's readable memory and meditation made from your day.
